source: NVIDIA NIM for LLMs Benchmarking Guide, documentation version 1.0.0, page "Performance"
context_columns: Model, NIM Version, Num of GPUs, GPU, Precision, TP, Input Tokens and Output Tokens come from the section headings above each table; Concurrency, TTFT (ms), ITL (ms) and Throughput(Tokens/s) are the table cells, unchanged.
metric: ITL is GenAI-Perf's (e2e_latency - TTFT) / (output_tokens - 1): decode only, TTFT excluded. Concurrency 1 is one request in flight.
hardware: NVIDIA DGX H100 (H100 80GB HBM3), DGX H200 (H200 141GB HBM3e) and DGX A100 (A100 SXM4 80GB), per the page's Hardware Specifications section.
